content: tmux: single server process owns all state (sessions/windows/panes in RB trees); window_pane owns PTY master fd+pid+libevent event; struct screen+grid = server-side virtual terminal emulation, so reattach re-renders from authoritative screen state rather than replaying bytes; clients are lightweight processes on a unix socket (proc.c imsg); all mutations serialized through a command queue on a single-threaded libevent loop; multi-client attach to same session supported, session groups via winlink indirection; per-client rendering (tty.c) so clients can have different sizes.
